source._comment: Arizona has no statewide by-party early-vote feed; each county recorder publishes separately. az_update.py reads Stealth Analytics' tracker (compiled from the counties' early-ballot files every two hours; 'free to cite and reuse with attribution'), with the UF Election Lab (which republishes it) as fallback. Maricopa's own ArcGIS feature services (services.arcgis.com/ykpntM6e3tHvzKRJ) still held the July primary on 2026-10-05.

maricopa._comment: Maricopa County Elections GIS public ArcGIS feature services (not behind the recorder site's Cloudflare check): early-ballot Requests and signature-verified Returns by precinct for the active election; all voters + R + D layers. Used for Maricopa when its returned count is ahead of (or level with) the tracker's.
